scope: exploratory reused source years and same sample as initial experiment
target: new observed permit presence; not confirmed franchise entry
selection: brandwise top1 hit on development entrants with >=2 absent districts
feature_time: permit dates <= December31 target-1; no target-year flows
model: fixed logistic C1 or HGB100 leaf7 min30 l2=10 lr=.05
definition: local permit records, five service shares, prior-year opening/closure rates; not complete retail census
